### Storms Only Last a Season
Author: Sarah Frazer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/storms-only-last-a-season-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 57:1
Points:
- Life often brings sudden and devastating trials that threaten to overwhelm our faith.
- Rather than trying to fix crises through self-reliance, we must turn to God as our true refuge.
- Difficult seasons are temporary, giving believers hope that the storm will eventually pass.
- God uses trials to carry out His sovereign purposes and shape believers into the image of Christ.
- Daily prayer and Scripture reading build the deep spiritual roots required to withstand future hardships.

### The Kind of Person God Uses
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-august-14-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 57:7
Points:
- God often chooses ordinary, overlooked people to accomplish His work so that He receives the glory.
- Believers cultivate a steadfast heart by fixing their eyes on the Lord rather than on their circumstances.
- Confidence in God leads to heartfelt praise and worship even in difficult times.
- Trusting God means surrendering the outcome of our lives entirely into His hands.
- God works through people who remain faithful and content in whatever tasks they are currently given.
